_README: Source-digest for scripts/build_structural_trajectories.py. Each driver entry lists per-key knot rates with a value-level source citation + confidence, so trajectories_v{N}.json is REPRODUCIBLE (build --check gates it). The driver values here are EXTRACTED FROM REAL SOURCES by scripts/extract_structural_sources.py (run it to rebuild from data/structural/sources/raw/): PWT 10.01, UN WPP 2024, ILOSTAT LFPR, EU KLEMS 2024 growth-accounts workbook, NGFS Phase 5. NOT illustrative. Documented limits (single-country EU KLEMS = Austria; NGFS sector intensities share the Final-Energy activity basis; forward knots = recent trend held flat; N/S+BRD/MIL archetypes) are tracked in docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md (1a-breadth).

provenance.source: PWT 10.01 (productivity) + UN WPP 2024 (population) + ILOSTAT LFPR (participation) + EU KLEMS & INTANProd 2024 release (sector MFP via LP1ConTFP, per-hour LP, labour share) + NGFS Phase 5 REMIND-MAgPIE 3.3-4.8 / Below 2C (per-archetype emissions intensity = sector CO2 / sector Final Energy)
provenance.licence: see per-entry sources; UN WPP: CC BY 3.0 IGO, PWT 10.01: CC BY 4.0, ILOSTAT: CC BY 4.0, EU KLEMS: CC BY 4.0, NGFS: see NGFS terms
provenance.notes: Per-region and per-sector annual growth trajectories for the Phase 7b.2 structural drivers, EXTRACTED FROM REAL SOURCES by scripts/extract_structural_sources.py and assembled by scripts/build_structural_trajectories.py (both --check-gated in CI). v4 (review-10 2026-09-14): NGFS emissions_intensity is now a genuine per-archetype INTENSITY = sector CO2 / sector Final Energy (was CO2/GDP, which double-counted the output-share change the CGE determines endogenously); __all__ and BRD/MIL share one gross energy+process boundary over Final Energy (AFOLU excluded); the low/high sensitivity variants were relabelled adverse/favourable (deterministic stress cases, not intervals) and gained pre-COVID EU KLEMS windows. v3 (review-8): EU KLEMS mfp = LP1ConTFP directly (was a dimensionally-wrong LP2_G/CAP_QI decomposition; capital_deepening retired); NGFS scenario an explicit validated tuple (Below 2C); global __all__ member-weighted; rates proportional (expm1). Rates are decimal fractions per year; the wrapper holds the most recent knot piecewise-constant. N (advanced) / S (emerging) region + BRD (goods) / MIL (services) sector archetypes, plus __all__. Per-value source strings carry geography/release/sheet/window/transform. Known limits (single-country EU KLEMS, NGFS sector intensities over a Final-Energy activity basis, held-flat forward knots, participation LOW confidence) are documented in docs/structural-data-pipeline-plan.md.

N.source: UN World Population Prospects 2024, Total Population (both sexes), Medium variant; knots 2025/2035/2050, each the interval CAGR to the next knot (final knot: one-year rate) so holding it reproduces the WPP level at the next knot; population-weighted over mapped countries per N/S archetype. https://population.un.org/wpp/

S.source: ILOSTAT indicator EAP_DWAP_SEX_AGE_RT (labour-force participation rate), SEX_T total, AGE_AGGREGATE_YGE15 (15+) band; per-country annualised log-trend over the recent ≤10-year window (latest obs ≥2015), expm1→proportional, clipped ±1%/yr; UNWEIGHTED archetype mean, held forward. LOW confidence: no labour-force size weights, single recent trend projected flat. https://ilostat.ilo.org/

NGFS Phase 5 scenario explorer: model REMIND-MAgPIE 3.3-4.8, scenario Below 2°C, region World; PER-CHANNEL emissions intensity (review-11 P1), each CO2 over the activity that drives it: electricity = CO2|Supply|Electricity / Secondary Energy|Electricity (generation); industry = CO2|Demand|Industry / FE|Industry (combustion); process = CO2|Industrial Processes / (Production|Steel + |Cement); transport = CO2|Demand|Transportation / FE|Transportation; buildings = CO2|Demand|Res+Comm / FE|Res+Comm; __all__ = (Energy + Industrial Processes) CO2 / total Final Energy. The concordance maps each model sector to its channel so electricity gets the generation path, not industry combustion. KNOWN GAP: FE/output (autonomous energy efficiency) is NOT sourceable per sector from NGFS (no sector output/VA) and the Leontief CGE does not reproduce it — these are combustion/energy-emissions intensities, NOT full CO2/output (hence LOW confidence). AFOLU excluded; a knot at every positive source year, CAGR to the next, last held flat (electricity truncates at its last positive year ~2080). https://data.ece.iiasa.ac.at/ngfs/
